booking_platform_note: SalonMonster is an Angular SPA; the rendered page shows only a loading shell to a plain HTTP client. Reverse-engineered the compiled app bundle to find the backend API root (https://api2.salonmonster.com/api) and used its public, unauthenticated endpoints (/salons/search/{subdomain}, /salons/{id}, /stylists, /stylists/{id}/servicedetails... note: servicedetails route that actually worked was /salons/{salonId}/stylists/{stylistId}/servicedetails) to pull the salon's real account record, staff record and full 45-item service menu with real prices and durations directly from the business's own live booking system. salonID=14235, stylistID=19777 (Elizabeth Gonzal,  title 'Skin Care'). Note online booking itself is currently reported as disabled on the account ("enableOnlineBooking":0) even though the widget page is live; the booking link is still the business's real, current, published contact channel and is used as the CTA per PIPELINE.md (the widget may simply require a client login step, or booking may currently be phone/DM based while the account exists) -- phone is offered as the primary immediate CTA alongside it.

hours_source: Two sources conflict slightly: reviews.birdeye.com states 'Monday-Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. | Sunday Closed'. The live Google Business Profile page (fetched Saturday 2026-08-08) showed 'Closed - Opens 10 AM' at the time of the fetch, suggesting Google's own hours record may differ (e.g. a later Saturday opening) from what Birdeye has cached. Since this is a single-operator appointment-based studio, hours documented on-site are presented as general guidance with a 'call or book to confirm' note rather than an exact hour-by-hour table, to avoid publishing a stale/conflicting number.

failed_reason: Minimum of 5-6 real, verifiably-this-business photos not met (0 found). Exhaustive research across the business's own booking platform backend (SalonMonster API: broken/removed stylist photo, no logo, no gallery endpoint), a live real-time Chromium fetch of the actual Google Business Profile (place explicitly confirmed to have 0 uploaded photos via the Photos viewer), three distinct Instagram account candidates (each individually verified via visual inspection of downloaded contact sheets to be a DIFFERENT business in a different city, based on phone numbers and booking links printed on their own promotional graphics), Facebook (the only matching-name page found is a different business, a tanning salon), Yelp (no listing exists for this address), and Birdeye (only default/stock placeholder imagery). This research was NOT degraded -- the Google Maps photo check was a first-party, real-time, JS-rendered browser session against the business's own verified listing (name/address/phone all matched exactly), not a limited API proxy; the SalonMonster data came directly from the business's own live backend API, and every discarded IG account was opened and visually confirmed as a mismatch, not assumed. Per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5 / FORGE-BRIEF section 0.b hard threshold ('menos de 5 fotos reales y propias del negocio... failed'), and the explicit task instruction not to fabricate imagery, this business is marked failed rather than built with stock/placeholder or misattributed photos. All other research (real full 45-item service menu with prices/durations, real phone, real email, real 5.0/18-review rating, 5 verbatim Google reviews) was completed and is preserved here in case usable photos surface later (e.g. if the owner uploads Google Business Profile photos or opens a real Instagram) and this can be revisited as a direct-command rebuild.
notes: Confirmed via two independent authoritative sources (SalonMonster's own account API and a live Google Business Profile browser fetch) that this is a real, currently operating, well-reviewed (5.0/18) single-esthetician facial and waxing studio with a genuine, detailed, currently-priced 45-item service menu. The blocker is purely visual assets: this business simply has not published photos anywhere publicly indexable at this time. Recommend flagging for a future retry if/when the owner adds Google Business Profile photos or opens a real, verifiable Instagram account.
